verdict.rationale: Community reports confirm that Twilio runs a 10DLC registration process that it requires even for low-volume senders (twilio-comm-17), including business registration paperwork (twilio-comm-15). However, no first-party docs in the pack describe a guided 10DLC brand/campaign flow or an approval-status view. The Console onboarding with status tracking (twilio-docs-22) covers toll-free verification, which is a different program, and Regulatory Bundles (twilio-docs-18) are adjacent features, so neither is credited here. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of guided 10DLC brand and campaign registration, an approval-status display, and hands-on corroboration of the walkthrough.
